info.name: CollabSpace AI - API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection for CollabSpace AI - AI-Powered Project Collaboration Platform

request.description:
Register a new user account on the CollabSpace AI platform.

### Access Control:
Public (No authentication required).

### Request Body:
- `name` (string, required): Full name of the user.
- `email` (string, required, email, unique): User's primary email address.
- `password` (string, required, min: 8): Account security password.
- `password_confirmation` (string, required): Matching password confirmation.
- `job_title` (string, optional): Job position title (e.g., Senior Full-Stack Engineer).
- `years_of_experience` (integer, optional, min: 0): Total years of professional experience.
- `phone` (string, optional): Contact mobile/phone number.

### Successful Response (201 Created):
Returns user entity, Bearer Sanctum token, and assigns default 'Team Member' role.

Authenticate using Administrator credentials to receive a high-privilege Bearer API token.

### Access Control:
Public.

### Credentials:
- `email`: `admin@collabspace.ai`
- `password`: `password123`
- `remember`: (boolean, optional): Extends token lifespan.

### Test Script:
Automatically updates the collection environment variable `{{token}}` with the returned access token.

Authenticate as Project Manager (Sarah Connor) to test PM-scoped workflows like scheduling meetings, assigning tasks, and generating AI summaries.

### Access Control:
Public.

### Credentials:
- `email`: `pm@collabspace.ai`
- `password`: `password123`

Authenticate as a standard Team Member (Alex Rivera) to test member-scoped capabilities such as updating task status, sending chat messages, and viewing assigned projects.

### Access Control:
Public.

### Credentials:
- `email`: `alex@collabspace.ai`
- `password`: `password123`

Initiate an automated password reset procedure.

### Access Control:
Public.

### Request Body:
- `email` (string, required, email): Registered account email address.

### Response (200 OK):
Sends a secure reset token via configured mail driver (or logs in local development).

Generate OAuth 2.0 redirection URL for third-party Single Sign-On (SSO).

### Supported Providers:
- `google`
- `facebook`
- `linkedin`

### Response:
HTTP 302 Redirect to provider consent screen or JSON containing redirect target.

Handle OAuth 2.0 provider callback code or simulate token exchange to authenticate/link user account.

### Access Control:
Public.

### Response (200 OK):
Returns authenticated user details and Bearer token.

Revoke and invalidate the current Bearer authentication token from the database.

### Access Control:
Requires `Bearer {{token}}` (auth:sanctum).

### Response (200 OK):
Tokens are revoked, preventing future unauthorized usage.

Retrieve comprehensive profile details of the authenticated user, including active roles, assigned projects, and team memberships.

### Access Control:
Requires `Bearer {{token}}`.

### Response Data:
User object, roles array, assigned projects with role pivots, and team roster.

Update personal profile information for the authenticated user.

### Request Body:
- `name` (string, optional)
- `job_title` (string, optional)
- `years_of_experience` (integer, optional)
- `phone` (string, optional)
- `avatar_url` (string, url, optional)

Securely change password for authenticated account.

### Request Body:
- `current_password` (string, required): Existing account password for verification.
- `new_password` (string, required, min: 8): New secure password.
- `new_password_confirmation` (string, required): Must match new_password.

### Access Control:
Requires `Bearer {{token}}`.

### Access Control:
Requires `Bearer {{token}}`.

List all workspace teams with member counts, active project counts, and leader details.

### Access Control:
Authenticated Users.

### Query Parameters:
- `page`: Page number (default: 1)
- `per_page`: Number of records (default: 15)
- `search`: Filter teams by name or description.

Create a new collaborative team inside the workspace.

### Access Control:
Administrators and Project Managers.

### Request Body:
- `name` (string, required, max: 255): Unique team title.
- `description` (string, optional): Objectives and team domain.
Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific team, including member directory, individual member roles, and assigned projects.

Update team metadata (name, description).

### Access Control:
Administrators and Team Leads.

Assign one or more users to a team with specific operational roles.

### Request Body:
- `members` (array, required): Array of member assignments.
  - `user_id` (integer, required, exists:users,id)
  - `role` (string, optional): One of 'Team Lead', 'Senior Member', 'Member', 'Contributor'.

Detach a specific user from the team.

### URL Parameters:
- `team`: Team ID
- `user`: User ID to remove

Delete an existing team. Safely dissociates attached project relations without cascade deleting projects.

### Access Control:
Administrators only.

List projects accessible to the authenticated user. Admins view all projects; PMs and Members view projects they created, belong to directly, or are assigned to via teams.

### Query Parameters:
- `page`: Page index
- `per_page`: Items per page
- `status`: Filter by 'Planning', 'In Progress', 'On Hold', 'Completed'
- `priority`: Filter by 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Critical'
- `search`: Keyword search in project name and description

Initialize and create a new project with deadlines, priorities, and budget metadata.

Administrators and Project Managers.

### Request Body:
- `name` (string, required, max: 255)
- `description` (string, optional)
- `start_date` (date, optional, YYYY-MM-DD)
- `deadline` (date, optional, after_or_equal:start_date)
- `priority` (string, required: Low, Medium, High, Critical)

Get in-depth analytical project metrics including progress percentage, task status breakdown, team velocity, meeting counts, and file statistics.

item.name: Get Project Teams & Task Progress (Figma Screen)

Update project metadata, dates, priority, or status. Note: progress percentage automatically re-calculates based on task completions.

Associate one or multiple teams to a project.

### Request Body:
- `team_ids` (array, required): List of existing team IDs [1, 2, ...]
Disassociate a team from a project.

Soft/Hard delete a project along with its cascade hierarchy (tasks, meetings, messages, attachments).

### Access Control:
Administrators and Project Creator.

- `priority` (string, optional: Low, Medium, High, Critical)
- `assigned_to` (integer, optional)

request.description:
Schedule a collaborative meeting with Google Meet / Zoom link, date, time slots, and attendee invites.

### Request Body:
- `project_id` (integer, required)
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, optional)
- `meeting_date` (date, required, YYYY-MM-DD)
- `start_time` (time, required, HH:MM:SS)
- `end_time` (time, required, after:start_time)
- `meeting_link` (string, url, optional)
- `attendee_ids` (array, optional): Array of invited user IDs.
Retrieve comprehensive meeting details, attendee attendance status, and attached AI summary.
Update meeting agenda, change dates/times, or update meeting URLs.

Update attendee attendance status for a meeting.

### Request Body:
- `user_id` (integer, required)
- `status` (string, required: 'attended', 'absent', 'excused')

Generate structured meeting summaries, key decisions, and actionable task items using Google Gemini 1.5 Flash (with intelligent local dynamic NLP fallback if external API is unreachable).

### Request Body:
- `notes` (string, optional): Meeting minutes / transcript to summarize. If omitted, uses existing meeting notes.
Retrieve existing AI-generated or manually refined meeting summary.
Allows project managers to manually edit and approve the AI summary, decisions, or action items.
